stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup — Series 3 Captains Set, Kowalik Leads Individual Race Into Aug. 24 Opener

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Series 3 captains for the 2026 AUSL All-Star Cup are set: Kayla Kowalik, Keilani Ricketts, Danieca Coffey, Devyn Netz. Kowalik leads the individual race heading in. Series 3 opens Aug. 24 at 3 PM ET. The race is on. 🥎 #AUSL #softball

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Kayla Kowalik is No. 1 on the individual leaderboard heading into AUSL All-Star Cup Series 3. Rookies Emma Lemley (+26 spots) and Korbe Otis (+22, now No. 10) made their moves in Series 2. Two series remain. Aug. 24 is next. 🥎 #AUSL

article.headline: Series 3 Captains Are Set — Kowalik Leads the 2026 AUSL All-Star Cup Heading Into Aug. 24

stories.title: Texas Longhorns 2027 — Defending Champions Begin New Chase With Kavan Senior Year

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text: Teagan Kavan is the first player in Women's College World Series history to win consecutive Most Outstanding Player awards. She is entering her senior year at Texas. The Longhorns are back-to-back national champions. The three-peat conversation starts now. 🥎 #HookEm

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text: Texas softball beat Texas Tech in the WCWS final in 2025. Then did it again in 2026. Mike White's program is 49-12 in the last season. Kavan's senior year in 2027 is must-watch. The Longhorns are the team everyone has to beat. 🥎 #HookEm #softball

article.headline: Kavan Is Back for One More Year — and Texas Is Already the Team to Beat in 2027

stories.title: USA WNT — 29 Days to WBSC World Cup Group Stage in Oklahoma City

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: 29 days until the USA opens the 2026 WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Group Stage in Oklahoma City. Sept. 12-16 at Devon Park. Garcia. Mulipola. Maxwell. Pickens. The same venue where USA went 8-2 at the IC two weeks ago. 🥎 #SoftballUSA

article.headline: 29 Days to Oklahoma City: USA Softball Eyes the World Cup Group Stage at Devon Park

stories.title: Texas Tech Softball 2027 — Fall Camp Approaching, Building Without Canady

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: NiJaree Canady is a Texas Volt now — drafted No. 2 overall in the AUSL draft, she turned pro. So Texas Tech 2027 builds without her. What remains: Kasidi Pickering (.384 avg, 50 career HR), Heavener (2.81 ERA), and a deep portal class. 🥎 #TexasTech

article.headline: Texas Tech 2027: Glasco Builds Without Canady — and the Red Raiders Still Have a Case
